titulo: Rapid bacterial community profiling of equine microbiomes using Oxford Nanopore sequencing
cuerpo: Members of the Horse Microbiome Research Group recently published a new study in the Journal of Medical Microbiology, led by Dr. Joy Leng, who is currently undertaking the Alborada Well Foal 2 project. This research aims to understand how the foal gut microbiome develops by investigating the microbiomes of mares and their foals.
